title: Notifications
description: What you have to do and what you should know, in one list.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.error: We could not load the notifications.

toast.error: We could not update the notification

empty.todo: Nothing to do. When something needs your action, it shows up here.
empty.fyi: Nothing new to know for now.
empty.title: You are up to date
empty.hint: Upcoming installments, received payments and insurer replies arrive here.

platform.title: No brokerage notifications
platform.hint: Notifications belong to each user of a brokerage. Radal team accounts do not receive portfolio alerts.

installment_overdue.title: Overdue installment · policy {{policy}}
installment_overdue.body: Installment {{cuota}} of {{insured}} is {{days}} days late · {{amount}}. Record the payment or a promise.

termination_risk.title: Termination risk · policy {{policy}}
termination_risk.body: Installment {{cuota}} is still unpaid after the collection cadence. Record the payment, a promise or the cancellation.

direct_debit_rejected.title: Direct debit rejected · policy {{policy}}
direct_debit_rejected.body: The automatic charge of installment {{cuota}} was rejected. Follow up with the policyholder.

promise_broken.title: Broken promise · policy {{policy}}
promise_broken.body: The promised date ({{promise}}) passed without payment of installment {{cuota}}.

plan_missing.title: Policy without a payment plan
plan_missing.body: Policy {{policy}} has no installments: load its payment plan so it enters Collections.

inquiry_reply.title: The insurer replied · policy {{policy}}
inquiry_reply.body: The reply to your payment status inquiry arrived. Review it and confirm what applies.

evidence_pending.title: Reported payment to confirm · policy {{policy}}
evidence_pending.body: A reported payment (installment {{cuota}}) is waiting for your confirmation.

payment_received.title: Payment received · policy {{policy}}
payment_received.body: The online payment of installment {{cuota}} for {{amount}} was recorded.

native_collection_available.title: Online collection available
native_collection_available.body: {{insurer}} now collects online: its open installments move to online collection by themselves.

portal_search_failed.title: The quote on {{portal}} did not finish
portal_search_failed.body: Check what happened and pick another path: retry, another portal or upload the quote as a PDF.

mail_account_error.title: Problem with your mailbox
mail_account_error.body: We could not connect the mailbox {{address}}. Check its settings.

sensitive_action.title: Sensitive action · policy {{policy}}
sensitive_action.body: There was a sensitive change on installment {{cuota}}. Review it.

policy_linked_insured.title: Policy linked to an existing insured
policy_linked_insured.body: {{by}} registered policy {{policy}} and linked it to {{insured}}, already in the portfolio.

unknown.title: Notification
unknown.body: Open the detail to see what happened.

sensitiveEvent.chargeback: The insurer reported a chargeback of the payment of installment {{cuota}}. Review the payment.
sensitiveEvent.provider_payment_unconverted: An online payment of installment {{cuota}} could not be converted to {{currency}}. Review it and record it by hand.
